body_html:
The Adapt high back synchro-tilter pairs a breathable black mesh back with a plush upholstered seat, delivering all-day airflow and support in a slim, modern silhouette. A weight-balanced synchro-tilter and height-adjustable lumbar keep posture honest through long working hours, while two arm configurations let you tune the chair to a private office or a shared conference room. Canadian-made and built to a 300 lb capacity, it earns its place as a dependable everyday task chair.

Features

  • Synchro-tilter mechanism with upright-position tilt lock and tilt tension adjustment
  • Pneumatic seat height adjustment with a 17"–22.5" range
  • Height-adjustable, flexible lumbar support
  • Breathable black mesh back over an upholstered, waterfall-edge seat
  • MVL11724: height- and width-adjustable arms with sliding arm caps; MVL11725: fixed open-loop arms
  • Black 5-prong fiberglass-reinforced nylon base with dual-wheel carpet casters
  • 300 lb weight capacity

Specifications

Overall dimensions 24.5"W x 24"D x 41.5"H. Mesh back in black; seat available in all Grade 1 seating textiles or LuxPlus vinyl in a range of colours. ANSI/BIFMA compliant and GREENGUARD Gold certified for low chemical emissions. Backed by a 2-year warranty on upholstery, foam and moving mechanisms.
